# Grouper

Type: Fish | Internal ID: fish7 | Source: Fishing | Usage: Cooking | Decoration | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Grouper are passive creatures (fish) found in the waters just offshore of the Plains biome.
They can be caught with a fishing pole using Stingy fishing bait which can be crafted at the Food preparation table by combining 20 Fishing bait and a Fuling trophy.
Needed to craft a Fishing hat

### Crafting:

• Food preparation table Raw fish
• Workbench Fishing hat
• Mead ketill Mead base: Anti-sting

## Notes

• Has a unique line: "I'm dead, but not gone. Won't you free me from this cursed purgatory?"

Categorias: Fish, Fishing
